headline.title: How we used Gemini to build Google I/O 2026
headline.summary: The article discusses the use of Google's Gemini AI in the development of the Google I/O 2026 event, highlighting its role in creating engaging content and experiences. It features various visual elements related to the event, including pop-up installations and multimedia presentations.

articles.title: Nvidia chases $200B CPU market with AI agent PCs from Microsoft, Dell, and HP
articles.summary: Nvidia is targeting the $200 billion CPU market by collaborating with Microsoft, Dell, and HP to introduce AI agent PCs. This initiative aims to make AI agents more accessible and practical for everyday users.

articles.title: This could be Windows’ M1 moment — but expect it to cost a ton
articles.summary: Nvidia has announced its entry into the consumer laptop chip market with the RTX Spark, potentially marking a significant shift for Windows devices similar to Apple's M1 transition. While Arm-based chips have demonstrated strong performance and battery life in Macs, Windows laptops have yet to achieve comparable results with Qualcomm chips, and the new Nvidia offering is expected to come at a high price.

articles.title: Gemini’s new AI agent is about as good as Google’s demo
articles.summary: Google's new AI agent, Gemini Spark, is designed to perform tasks on behalf of users, showcasing impressive capabilities during a recent demonstration. However, concerns regarding its financial cost and potential privacy implications have been raised.

articles.title: Florida sues OpenAI, Sam Altman, in first-of-its-kind lawsuit over violent incidents
articles.summary: Florida has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO Sam Altman, claiming that ChatGPT played a role in a shooting incident at Florida State University last year. This marks the first lawsuit of its kind, focusing on the potential influence of AI technology in violent events.

articles.title: Meta’s own AI was exploited to hijack Instagram accounts
articles.summary: Meta's AI support chatbot was exploited by hackers to hijack Instagram accounts by manipulating the system to change account emails and reset passwords. The company acknowledged the issue and is reportedly working on a fix.

articles.title: Introducing Mellum2: A 12B Mixture-of-Experts Model by JetBrains
articles.summary: JetBrains has introduced Mellum2, a 12 billion parameter mixture-of-experts model designed to enhance AI capabilities in software development. This model aims to improve code completion, error detection, and other programming tasks by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques.

articles.title: Water access is now a risk factor in SpaceX’s IPO
articles.summary: SpaceX has identified access to sufficient water resources as a significant risk factor for its upcoming IPO, citing the need for substantial water to cool its data centers. The company faces challenges in securing abundant and affordable water supplies.

articles.title: This AI weather startup is out-forecasting government agencies
articles.summary: AI weather startup WindBorne is outperforming government agencies by utilizing a network of 400 balloons that collect sensor data from 15 global launch sites. The company's forecasting accuracy has improved through enhanced data integration into its predictive models.

articles.title: DuckDuckGo makes its ‘no-AI’ search engine easier to access as its traffic booms
articles.summary: DuckDuckGo has introduced 'no AI' web extensions for Chrome and Firefox, making its alternative search engine more accessible as user traffic increases. The move aligns with the company's commitment to providing a search experience free from AI-generated content.

articles.title: Building the infrastructure for the Intelligence Age in Michigan
articles.summary: OpenAI has commenced construction on a 1GW data center in Michigan as part of its Stargate initiative, aimed at enhancing AI infrastructure. The project is expected to expand access to AI technologies, generate employment opportunities, and benefit local communities.

articles.title: AI is blowing up music. How should the Grammys handle it?
articles.summary: Harvey Mason Jr., CEO of the Recording Academy, discusses the impact of generative AI on the music industry and its implications for the Grammy Awards. The conversation reflects on the evolving landscape of music creation and the challenges the Grammys face in adapting to these changes.
